evidence.description: The 'endpoint' variable is force unwrapped using 'endpoint!' in the 'NetworkConfiguration' initializer.

candidates.explanation: The code force unwraps the 'endpoint' variable, which is derived from 'urlProvider.snowplowMicro' or 'urlProvider.snowplow'. If either provider returns nil, the application will crash at runtime.
candidates.title: Force Unwrapping of Optional Value

evidence.description: The 'shouldUseMicroInstance' property setter calls 'Analytics.updateTrackerController()', which modifies the 'tracker' property of the 'shared' instance.
The 'updateTrackerController' method assigns a new tracker to 'Analytics.shared.tracker'.

candidates.explanation: The 'Analytics' class uses a shared singleton instance ('shared') and a static property ('shouldUseMicroInstance') that modifies the 'tracker' property of the shared instance. Since 'updateTrackerController' is called from a property setter, concurrent access to these properties from different threads could lead to race conditions.
candidates.title: Potential Thread Safety Issue with Shared Singleton

evidence.description: The 'sendAnonymousUsageDataSetting' method calls 'tracker.track(...)' directly instead of using the 'track(...)' method defined on the class.
The 'track(_:)' method contains logic to append context and check for the 'TESTING' macro.

candidates.explanation: The 'sendAnonymousUsageDataSetting' method directly accesses and uses the 'tracker' property, while other methods in the class use the 'track(_:)' wrapper method. This bypasses the logic in 'track(_:)' which handles 'Structured' event context appending and 'TESTING' flag checks.
candidates.title: Inconsistent Tracker Usage
